evidence.description: FIND-004 closed: TestSanitizeName parametrize now asserts exact equality (sanitize_name(inp) == expected) with no conditional fallback. 'スキャン-coconala' → 'coconala' (exact), plus 2 new rigorous cases 'foo!@#bar' → 'foo-bar' and 'ABC-日本-XYZ' → 'abc-xyz'.

FIND-002 closed: TestNoveltyRatioZeroGuard exercises 3 cases — novelty_ratio=0 empty history, novelty_ratio=0 WITH saturated history (= explicitly forces the int(1/0) old code path), negative ratio. Removing the '> 0' gate would crash test #2.

FIND-003 closed: snapshots tasks/ + build_log section count BEFORE dispatch, asserts len(new_tasks) <= 1 and (sections_after - sections_before) <= 1. A double-append regression would now fail the test.
novelty_ratio > 0 guard present; ZeroDivisionError pre-empted; matches REQ-M3(v) semantics.
Regression guards added in the topically-correct test file (recipe + dispatcher kill-primitives), not crammed into an unrelated test module.

FIND-001 closed: test_dispatcher_has_no_tmux_kill_or_stop + test_step3_recipe_has_no_tmux_kill regex-scan both files for {tmux kill, --stop, --kill, kill-session, kill-server}. Confirmed live grep returns 0 hits in proactive-loop-dispatch.py. Adding any one pattern would fail the regression guard the verification architecture (PROP-I1) demands.
